title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1985-04-08
lineage: Cassette Master (Maxell Metaxial 90) -> Tascam 112, dolbyB -> RCA/XLR -> Edirol m10dx 24bit 96kHz -> SPDIF -> M-Audio MicrotrackII compact flash -> USB -> Wave Lab 5.0 -> R8brain 16bit 44.1kHz -> Traders Little Helper flac8

ai_review.summary: Unknown source recording of a sloppily executed show that many reviewers deem far below the Dead's usual standards
ai_review.review: The sole fan review condemns the performance as degenerate, citing sloppy playing, dragging tempos and Garcia "gasping for air" throughout much of the concert. No technical details about the tape are offered, leaving the recording quality ambiguous, but the overall impression is a disappointing show that fails to live up to hype.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one negative review (2 stars) focusing on poor musical performance; no recording‑quality information, so rating reflects the strong dislike of the show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review does not mention sound quality, mix, or source type; no specific audio issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer describes the first set as having a few nice moments but says the concert quickly devolves into sloppy, dragging playing for the remainder of the show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar work described as "gasping for air" and generally sloppy.
